curriculum: California Common Core State Standards for Mathematics (CA CCSSM)

items.cluster: Count to tell the number of objects
items.title: Count Objects and Ten-Frames
items.prompt: How many red counters are shown on the ten-frame below?
items.explanation: Five counters fill the top row and three fill the bottom row: 5 + 3 = 8.
items.hint: Count the 5 counters in the top row first, then add the 3 below.

items.title: Addition Fluency within 20
items.explanation: Take 2 from 5 to make a 10 with 8: 8 + 2 = 10, then 10 + 3 = 13.

items.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations
items.title: Addition within 1,000
items.explanation: Add ones: 8+5=13 (write 3, carry 1). Add tens: 5+7+1=13 (write 3, carry 1). Add hundreds: 2+1+1=4. Total = 433.
items.hint: Remember to carry to both the tens and hundreds places.

items.title: Multiplication Fact Fluency
items.explanation: 9 groups of 7 equals 63. You can also think (10 × 7) - 7 = 70 - 7 = 63.
items.hint: Think of 10 × 7 minus one group of 7.

items.title: Equivalent Fractions
items.hint: Multiply both the top and bottom by 2.

items.title: Order of Operations (PEMDAS)
items.explanation: 1. Parentheses: 6 × 3 = 18. 2. Addition & subtraction left to right: 4 + 18 - 2 = 20.
items.hint: Perform the operation inside the parentheses first.
